messages:
Emma P.: Quick design review — perm panel microcopy + SSO breadcrumb behavior. Mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/perm-panel. Thoughts?

Raj D.: Saw the mock. The roles matrix feels dense when there are >8 roles. Can we collapse secondary permissions into a hover/expand? Also contrast on the 'enforced' badge is low :warning:

Maria G.: Technical constraint: audit log endpoint returns 500 items/page and cursoring is async. If we jump straight to an anchor when someone clicks 'View in audit', we need server-side anchors or client-side fetch+scroll. Prefer client-side lazy load + scroll-to-id.

Leo T.: UX thought — move the SSO toggle into the invite drawer header with a small helper: "When SSO is ON, invited users must sign-in via SSO". That reduces confusion about per-role vs org-level enforcement. @Raj D. will that fit visually?

Raj D.: Yeah, here's two quick microcopy options for the header/help text (short):

Option A:
```
SSO enforcement
All invites require Single Sign-On. Users will be redirected to your IdP at first login.
```

Option B:
```
SSO required for new invites
Turned on at the org level — users must use your configured IdP.
```

Which is clearer? I prefer A for clarity.

Emma P.: Let's A/B test A vs B on the signup flow. Metrics: invite completion rate, support tickets mentioning login, and time-to-accept. Can we get a simple 2-week experiment? :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

Maria G.: Accessibility nits: role chips need keyboard focus states and an aria-label like "role: Reader, 3 permissions". Also the expand chevron should be reachable by keyboard (enter/space to expand). I'll add a short accessibility checklist to the ticket.

Raj D.: Agreed. Proposed small code tweak for the chip:
```
<button class="role-chip" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="role: Admin, 7 permissions">Admin</button>
```

Leo T.: I'll add a small tooltip copy and make sure the SSO toggle has an aria-describedby linking to the help text. Also propose adding a 'View in audit' confirmation modal if the target event is not yet loaded.

Emma P.: Action items — Raj: iterate mock with compact state + A/B variants (due Thu). Maria: accessibility checklist + prototype keyboard nav (due Fri). Leo: update invite drawer layout and annotate component in Figma (due Mon). I'll create the ticket and assign. Thanks team!
